summary: Manual certification test of 7 scenarios. 5/7 PASS, 2 with P1 issues. Key finding: JourneyWelcomePage (welcome_token URL) is missing Atelier action panel with 'Visualizza le Direzioni' CTA. TEST_AdminSession placeholder text visible in client journey portal. Overall verdict: NOT CERTIFIED (2 P1 issues blocking full flow).

TEST_1_BeginJourney.details: Multi-step wizard loads correctly in Italian. Locale IT confirmed. No raw i18n keys. Steps: ATMOSFERA → COME VIVI → CONOSCIAMOCI. Interactive fields work.

TEST_2_ClientAccess_WelcomeToken.details: 'Benvenuta, Valentina.' correctly displayed. No demo/placeholder text. Studio name correct. However NO 'Visualizza le Direzioni' CTA on this page (JourneyWelcomePage is a static welcome page, not Atelier client portal).

TEST_3_DesignerReceivesClient.details: Prospects=12, Valentina Certificazione visible as top prospect. Owner: Stefano Ogrisek (correct). 'Apri Journey' CTA present. No demo data.

TEST_4_Messaging.details: Leads=15, Valentina visible as first lead. Notification badge with count '7' visible in header. Leads page functional.

TEST_5_ConceptDirectionPublishing.details: Journey workspace at /journey/:id loads. 'Visualizza le Direzioni™' CTA present. BUT: quote area shows 'TEST_AdminSession apre il proprio Design Journey™...' — hardcoded test data artifact visible. Journey shows 'Benvenuto, Stefano' (designer) instead of Valentina data.

TEST_6_ClientPortalUX.details: At /journey/:id the Atelier portal renders with 'Visualizza le Direzioni™', 'Continua il Brief Guidato™', 'Scrivi al tuo referente', 'Possiamo sentirci?' CTAs. AtelierNotifications shows real count (7). BUT welcome_url (/journey/welcome/:token) does NOT show Atelier action panel — only shows static journey summary.

TEST_7_JourneyStateConsistency.details: Prospects API (auth required): 12 items, Valentina present. Accounts API: 16 items, Valentina present with journey_lifecycle_state='conversation_open', journey_id='60c3e5df'. Direct /api/journeys/:id returns 404 (uses different route).

minor.issue: Returns 404 — journey data accessible only through accounts API, not direct journey lookup

ui_bugs.issue: Quote block shows 'TEST_AdminSession apre il proprio Design Journey™...' — test data artifact visible in production client portal. This is a P1 hardcoded test data issue.

integration_issues.issue: JourneyWelcomePage (/journey/welcome/:token) does NOT show AtelierActionPanel with 'Visualizza le Direzioni' CTA. Welcome URL is a static summary page, not the full Atelier client portal. Client cannot navigate to concept directions from welcome_url.

action_items: FIX P1: Remove TEST_AdminSession from journey brief quote — appears to be from a seed/test journey that contaminated the client portal view

FIX P1: JourneyWelcomePage (/journey/welcome/:token) should either (a) redirect to /journey/:id after token verification, or (b) include AtelierActionPanel with 'Visualizza le Direzioni' CTA so clients can navigate to concept directions
VERIFY: When designer opens /journey/:id for Valentina's journey while logged in as admin, should show Valentina's data not admin test data
